title: Adverbs | Grade 2 English for Kids | Little Takhti
description:
What is an adverb? Watch the turtle walk slowly and the rabbit hop quickly, learn how to add -ly (and the y to i rule), and find adverbs that tell when, where and how often. Then try a quick quiz with Takhti. For Grade 2 children (ages 7 to 8).

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.netlify.app/class-2-english-adverbs-worksheets/

Chapters
0:00 Hello
0:11 What is an adverb?
0:28 Adding -ly
0:45 When, where and how often
0:58 Quiz
1:47 Remember

Little Takhti makes free learning for children in Pakistan, Nursery to Grade 3. https://littletakhti.netlify.app
